 FPL Price Risers 📈
 Konsa
 Club: Arsenal
 Ownership: 24.7%
 New price: £4.9m
 Konsa has been in outstanding form. He scored 14 points against Everton, keeping a clean sheet, then followed up with 10 points in a clean sheet victory over Liverpool. He added eight more points against Hull City last weekend. That is 32 points across three gameweeks. His next fixture against Newcastle is average in difficulty, making him an attractive option at his new price.
